title: Affine quadratic stationarity pencils, reciprocal critical Hessians and the two endpoint strata

newly_cached_primary_context.portions_inspected: Versioned v2 primary abstract and bibliographic record only; no body theorem is claimed independently checked.
newly_cached_primary_context.role: Primary global-residue context only. No toric, multivariate Euler-Jacobi or missing-infinity theorem is imported; the required one-variable partial-fraction statement is reproduced directly.

retained_structural_inputs.statement: Critical Hessians under a polynomial source automorphism acquire one common constant determinant factor; also reproved in JF0.
Under hypothetical nonautomorphy, zero and one reduced critical points give exactly the old unit-ideal and singleton-zero plane Keller endpoint orbits; both have conditional converses.
The self-adjoint primary-chain normalization and the centered nilpotent quadratic orbit are retained; JF cyclic moment proof needs only elementary chain pairing.
The whole common-center graph family is already classified to the singleton endpoint; independent linear offsets are the present extension.
A certified ambient quadratic similitude rescales actual source functions, preserving the stated obstruction and endpoint reductions.
The literal ambient normal form transfers genuine quadratic-ambient graph embeddings to the original Meng-Yang potential.
